name: Grandalen - Bottenstugan
description: Grandalen to Bottenstugan. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: Bottenstugan drinking-water tap: Drinking-water tap behind Bottenstugan, described by Vastkuststiftelsen as available during the summer half-year.
notes: Before final import, recheck the WST forestry/gravel-road status between Ovre and Nedre Langevatten and the Svartedalen storm-damage notice.
Field-check Bottenstugan water signage and seasonality before marking it as reliable drinking water.
Cluster Bottenstugan north/south shelters, fireplace, dry toilet, tent place, water tap, information board and possible grillkata/access shelter to avoid duplicate records.
De-duplicate repeated coordinates before length, snapping, simplification or route matching.
GPX elevation values are zero and should not be imported as elevation.
Official WST declared distance 8.5 km is longer than computed WST geometry length about 8.127 km.

facilities.name: Etapptavla Grandalen
facilities.description: Official Stage 8 start board at Grandalen.

facilities.name: Abborrvattnets badplats
facilities.description: Swimming/bathing place near early Stage 8 in Svartedalen. Do not import as drinking water; natural lake water requires treatment if used.

facilities.name: Vindskydd Tvangen
facilities.description: Wind shelter along Stage 8 near Tvangen. Check local signs for overnight use, firewood and exact campsite suitability.

facilities.name: Vindskydd Ovre Langevatten
facilities.description: Wind shelter by Ovre Langevatten; field reports describe scenic placement but limited tent space and no guaranteed toilet/firewood. Nearby forestry/gravel-road construction between Ovre and Nedre Langevatten is active trail-status context. Do not mark firewood or toilet as available unless separately verified.

facilities.name: Vindskydd Holmevatten
facilities.description: Wind shelter near Holmevatten on the latter part of Stage 8. Do not import the older 2022 Bottenstugan-Holmevatten detour notice as current without live confirmation.

facilities.name: Utsikt Alevatten
facilities.description: Viewpoint near Alevatten shortly before Bottenstugan.

facilities.name: Parkeringsplats Bottenstugan
facilities.description: Bottenstugan endpoint parking/access area. Parking can fill on weekends. Use designated parking only.

facilities.name: Bottenstugan drinking-water tap
facilities.description: Drinking-water tap behind Bottenstugan, described by Vastkuststiftelsen as available during the summer half-year. Source conflict: older Kungalv booking text says well water is not drinkable and water must be brought. Do not mark as winter or shoulder-season reliable.

facilities.name: Torrdass Bottenstugan
facilities.description: Dry toilet at Bottenstugan endpoint cluster.

facilities.name: Taltplats Bottenstugan
facilities.description: Tent/camping area at the Bottenstugan endpoint cluster. Svartedalen rules vary by sub-area; use designated sites and follow on-site signs. Nearby reserve areas 1 and 2 prohibit tenting, so do not generalize tenting permission outside the Bottenstugan designated area.

facilities.name: Eldstad Bottenstugan
facilities.description: Fireplace/grill at Bottenstugan; facilities lane notes renovation/confirmation context from January 2025 WST material. Fire only where allowed and only if no fire ban or local restriction applies. Bring own wood if needed; do not assume firewood supply.

facilities.name: Vindskydd sodra Bottenstugan
facilities.description: Southern wind shelter in the Bottenstugan endpoint cluster. Cluster with Bottenstugan north shelter, fireplace, toilet and tent place to avoid duplicate endpoint records.

facilities.name: Vindskydd norra Bottenstugan
facilities.description: Northern wind shelter in the Bottenstugan endpoint cluster. Cluster with Bottenstugan south shelter, fireplace, toilet and tent place to avoid duplicate endpoint records.

facilities.name: Bottenstugan information boards/maps
facilities.description: Information board/map cluster at Bottenstugan. Useful access metadata; may not need a separate user-facing facility record.
